agents.name: Evidence Agent
agents.role: Collects inventory, supplier and expiry facts
agents.summary: Capture antibody lot expires on day 12; replacement arrives day 18.
reasoning: Parsed 7 materials and 3 incoming shipments from the experiment record.
Capture antibody current lot (192 µg remaining by day 11) is flagged unusable from day 12.
Next capture antibody shipment (300 µg) is scheduled for day 18 — a 6-day gap.
Streptavidin-HRP consumption with 8% waste trends below 2 mL safety stock late in the run.
agents.conclusion: Two signals: a hard expiry gap on a critical reagent and a soft safety-stock breach.

agents.name: Hypothesis Agent
agents.summary: The experiment fails because of expiry timing, not consumption volume.
reasoning: H1: Capture antibody runs out from over-consumption — rejected; stock is 192 µg at expiry, well above safety.
H2: Lot expiry before resupply creates a stockout window — supported by days 12–17 shortfall.
H3: Strep-HRP waste rate causes late-run safety breach — plausible, non-blocking.
agents.conclusion: H2 is primary. Reducing usage alone will not restore feasibility.

agents.name: Experiment Agent
agents.summary: Ran 4 scenarios against the day-by-day material model.
reasoning: S1: pull capture antibody shipment forward to day 11.
S2: cut capture antibody use 25% via half-volume coating.
S3: add a 4 mL Strep-HRP top-up on day 16.
S4: combine S1 + S3.
agents.conclusion: Only S4 reaches FEASIBLE across all 21 days.

agents.name: Critic Agent
agents.summary: S2 is a false fix; S1 depends on the supplier honoring express delivery.
reasoning: S2 changes assay sensitivity — half-volume coating needs re-validation.
S1 assumes the 14-day lead time compresses to 10 days at +$420 express cost; supplier confirmed feasible in prior orders.
Strep-HRP top-up within 7-day lead time is realistic if ordered by day 9.
agents.conclusion: Accept S4 with an explicit order deadline; reject S2.

agents.name: Scientific Planner
agents.role: Synthesizes a recommended plan for human approval
agents.summary: Expedite capture antibody to day 11 and add a Strep-HRP top-up on day 16.
reasoning: Combined plan keeps assay protocol unchanged.
Total added cost ≈ $572; no schedule slip against day-24 deadline.

recommendations.rationale: Closes the day 12–17 stockout window caused by lot expiry.
